{{Quote|You had a Rebel&mdash;a potential Jedi, at that&mdash;in your grasp, and not only did you fail to extract any useful information from him, you allowed his Master to rescue him, from the Emperor's throneworld, no less.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to [[Antinnis Tremayne]]|<ref name="DV">{{GalaxyCite|8|Dark Vendetta (short story)}}</ref>}}
A '''throneworld''',<ref name="DE4" /> alternatively spelled as '''throne world'''<ref name="DE5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref> or '''throne-world''',<ref name="SotES" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that served as the [[Capital/Legends|seat of power]] for a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchist]] government.<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Declaration of a New Order|Declaration]] of a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] throneworld and its name was officially changed to "Imperial Center."<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] served as an auxiliary throneworld for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in the event that Coruscant was lost.<ref name="FDCR" />

{{Planet-stub}}
